create_sim_agent: create a SimAgent instance to define a simulated character in a PyBullet scene with configurable actuation
actuate_character: actuate a SimAgent character using stable PD, PD, torque, or constraint-based control modes
set_character_pose: set a SimAgent character pose from a motion pose object with optional velocity
get_character_pose: get a SimAgent character pose as a motion.Pose object from current joint and root states
save_restore_states: save and restore SimAgent simulation states for checkpointing and rollback
